q27.
**Go `//go:embed` of the built `dist/*` directory, served over Echo's static-file middleware (with SPA fallback to `index.html`); `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`**

The compiled React build is embedded into the Go binary at compile time via `//go:embed dist/*` (line 20), exposed as `embeddedFiles embed.FS`. In `FrontendService.Serve` (lines 41–61), `fs.Sub(embeddedFiles, "dist")` produces the static filesystem, which is registered on the Echo server through `middleware.StaticWithConfig` (lines 54–57). A `spaFallbackMiddleware` (lines 63–80) catches 404s on non-API/non-asset paths and serves `index.html` so client-side routing works. All of this is wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.
